# `cellar` params (platformer)

<!-- Generated by `pnpm docs:gen` from the `paramsSchema` of mini game `cellar` in `games/samples/platformer`'s `miniGames(content)`. Do not edit by hand: `pnpm docs:check` (part of `pnpm test`) fails when this page is out of date. -->

CELLAR: a mini game the game `platformer` defines (`HeadlessEntry.miniGames` in
`games/samples/platformer`), so its id is the game's, not a kit's. Its `params` are written where the game's
content names it; `pnpm cli validate` checks them with the content. See the
[schema reference](../schemas.md#mini-game-params) for the kits' own mini games.

- Named in: games/samples/platformer/content/levels/level-5.json (triggers.0.params)

| Field   | Type                      | Required | Default | Limits | Description                                                            |
| ------- | ------------------------- | -------- | ------- | ------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `goal`  | `"defeat-all" \| "reach"` | yes      |         |        | what the round asks: every enemy beaten, or an exit tile reached       |
| `ticks` | `integer`                 | no       |         | >= 1   | the time limit in ticks (1800 when left out)                           |
| `hp`    | `integer`                 | no       |         | >= 1   | the hero's hit points in half hearts (the kit's default when left out) |
